description.zh: 查询关键字，支持实例Id，实例名称精确搜索。
description.en: The keyword for an exact match search by instance ID or instance name.

description.zh: 是否需要额外信息，默认为**false**。
description.en: Specifies whether to return detailed information. The default value is **false**.

description.zh: 当前页数，起始值为**1**，默认为**1**。
description.en: The page number. The value starts from **1**. The default value is **1**.

description.zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值**100**，默认为**20**。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query. The maximum value is **100**. The default value is **20**.
The ID of the resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns describe-gtm-instances --lang en --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --keyword test --resource-group-id rg-xxxxx --need-detail-attributes false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns DescribeGtmInstances --region cn-hangzhou --NeedDetailAttributes false --PageSize 20 --Keyword test --ResourceGroupId 'rg-xxxxx' --PageNumber 1 --Lang en
